PB33-001.name: The BladeEmperorTigerDeity Blade-Tiger
PB33-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's, or an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest BP. When this effect destroys, once per turn, if it's your turn, send an opposing Life to the Trash, and this Spirit refreshes.

[LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, activate one of this Spirit's (When Attacks) effects. The part of that effect which targets opposing Spirits/Ultimates can't be prevented by opposing effects.

PB33-007.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Cost 5 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from your Hand onto your target Spirit.

[During Advent] [LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can't be destroyed via BP comparison. Also, while there is any six-colored Spirit card among this Spirit's pre-advent cards, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attacks Step)
Once per turn, either draw a card, or put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Then, if it's the opposing Attack Step, refresh this Spirit.

PB33-005.name: The Intercepting Blue Sea City
PB33-005.effect:
Unless via your "Azure Wave" family effect, this card in Trash can't be deployed.

(Once per Turn: Same Name) During the opposing turn, when your Blue-only Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can deploy this card from the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
Draw two cards, then discard two cards from your Hand. Then, when it's not deployed from the Hand, destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the lowest cost.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
You can refresh two "Azure Wave" family Spirits you control.

PB33-004.effect:

[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
Draw two cards. Then, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -12000 BP. Then, return every opposing 0 BP Spirit to the deckbottom.

[LV2]
Every opposing Spirit gets -1000 BP. For each “The Land of Rabbits” in your Trash, this “BP- effect” reduces 3000 further.

PB33-008.effect:

[During Set] (When Set)
You can summon a "MoonlightDragon Strike-Siegwurm" in your Hand/Soul State, without paying the cost.

When your "MoonlightDragon Strike-Siegwurm" would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by summoning/discarding this Mirage, all of such targets remain on the Field, in the same condition.

PB33-003.effect:

[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can banish two cards from the opposing Trash. Or, you can put a core from the Void to any of your Spirit/Nexus.

[LV2]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Including those that are in Soul State/pre-advent condition, while you control any Green Contract Spirit, when the opponent would summon any Spirit card via an effect, by heavy exhausting this refreshed Nexus, it is summoned in exhausted state.
